topics.label: Introduction to the Hallmarks of Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This opening section frames the lecture by reviewing previous content, defining learning outcomes, and introducing the hallmarks of cancer conceptual framework.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferative Signaling and Growth Suppressor Evasion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell-surface receptors and intracellular cascades drive cell-autonomous proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how malignant transformation prevents progenitor cells from completing terminal differentiation, using leukemias and intestinal crypts as examples.

topics.label: Evasion of Apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic describes how mutations in p53 and imbalance among Bcl-2 family members prevent cancer cells from triggering programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Cellular Senescence
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells bypass telomere-dependent senescence and stress-induced arrest to acquire indefinite proliferative capacity, concluding the survey of cell-intrinsic growth control.

topics.label: Cancer Metabolism and Metabolic Reprogramming
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how cancer cells alter their energy metabolism through aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic enzyme mutations produce onco-metabolites that remodel the epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the physiological necessity, developmental timing, and molecular balance of activators and inhibitors governing new blood vessel recruitment in tumors.

topics.label: Tumor Invasion and Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the metastatic cascade, diagnostic tracking using sentinel lymph nodes and circulating tumor cells, and the seed-and-soil requirements for secondary colonization.

topics.label: Conclusion and Final Summary
topics.groupedBecause: This closing section provides concluding framing by synthesizing the hallmarks framework, citing recent literature, and directing students to upcoming practical sessions.
